contracts.description: Local applications are admitted only while own source/destination NSDP count is below16; suppressed attempts have no generated packet identity.

NSDP count selects matching original source and destination among retained owners. Relay-source7 custody at node8 does not directly increase source8 local-flow NSDP; both use shared downstream service.
DSCP-zero DATA appends; positive DSCP prepends. Eligible queue scan skips submitted and route/admission-blocked entries. There is no explicit local-versus-relay priority branch.
Admission counters continue after the first100000 detailed admission rows. Protocol traces remain separate and complete. Blocked-reason time series must not be invented beyond the detailed prefix.
Keep actual-tx default. The native queued retry expiration distinction was already tested in T19, whose experiment was not promoted; do not assume it explains every T21 residual.

limitations: Historical native source semantics cited from retained T18 source audit at the same unchanged pin.
Source contracts alone do not demonstrate a cause of a numerical discrepancy.
Unsubmitted custody time is not automatically route waiting or capacity blocking time.

adaptive_window_contract.third_ack_growth: Increment and test ACK accumulator first; increase threshold capped16; then reset accumulator if retried ACK.
adaptive_window_contract.dack: Reset ACK accumulator; no decrease to threshold; retain HOP capacity until delayed hold expiry.
adaptive_window_contract.final_data_failure: Reset ACK accumulator and decrease threshold toward0.
